part.text:
Fixed the `Context.res` setter merge behavior.

## Changes

**`src/context.ts:414`** — Reworked the `res` setter so `Set-Cookie` headers are merged instead of replaced:
- Merges cookies from an existing `c.res` with cookies on the newly assigned `Response`.
- Falls back to `#preparedHeaders` when `c.res` has not been materialized yet, so cookies staged by `c.header()`/`setCookie()` before `next()` survive a raw `Response` return.
- Deduplicates exact cookie values to avoid duplicates when a response is rebuilt from `c.res` (e.g. `new Response(body, c.res)`).
- Preserves existing behavior where ordinary prepared (non-cookie) headers are not merged into a raw response.
- Clears staged headers when `c.res = undefined`, preventing stale cookies from leaking into the next assigned response.

**`src/context.test.ts:430`** — Updated the existing reassignment test to expect merged cookies, and added regression tests:
- `src/context.test.ts:447` — middleware cookie on `c.res` + handler `Set-Cookie` both survive.
- `src/context.test.ts:461` — prepared cookie + raw handler response both survive.
- `src/context.test.ts:472` — no duplication when `c.res` is read before reassignment.
